article.story: POCATELLO, Idaho -- — Malachi Johnson’s 39 points led Idaho State over South Dakota State 86-71 on Friday. Johnson had 13 rebounds for the Bengals (1-4). MaCarhy Morris scored 16 points and added six assists. Kenyon DeMuynck shot 4 of 7 from the field, including 1 for 3 from 3-point range, and went 5 for 9 from the line to finish with 14 points. Joe Sayler led the Jackrabbits (5-1) in scoring, finishing with 25 points. Jon Mekonnen added 14 points for South Dakota State. Davis Kern finished with 10 points and eight rebounds. The loss broke the Jackrabbits’ five-game winning streak. Up next Up next for Idaho State is a matchup Tuesday with Boise State on the road. South Dakota State hosts Abilene Christian on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
